CREATE TABLE school_focus_evidence (
	school_unit_code TEXT, 
	school_name TEXT, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	retrieved_at DATETIME, 
	scope_status TEXT, 
	collection_scope TEXT, 
	method_version TEXT, 
	robots_url TEXT,
